ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels across the total visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous white field with dark vertical striations originating from the leading edge; right lobe exhibits a dominant dark central field with white mottling concentrated at the distal edge and tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; the visible margins converge at approximately a 70-degree angle, though the vertex base is occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; right lobe displays higher pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) compared to the more continuous serration on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical sweep on both lobes, curving toward acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters of barnacles (white/tan) localized along the leading edge margins and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dark, unaligned vertical linear marks and rake-like disruptions visible on the white pigmentation field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization and irregular trailing edge topography suggesting historical tissue loss or environmental wear.
